title: supervisor-state.json of a project
description: The memory of the supervisor of a project (<runs root>/supervisor-state.json), replaced atomically under supervisor.lock: per run the recoveries it started (the breaker), whether it gave the run up and the last thing it saw. A run it gave up stays untouched until the owner resumes it by hand.

runs.description: The runs the supervisor has acted on, by run id.

run.description: What the supervisor remembers of one run.

recoveries.description: UTC times of the resumes the supervisor started; the breaker counts those within window_s.

given_up.description: UTC time the breaker opened (max_recoveries within window_s), null while it is closed.

resumes_at_give_up.description: Number of run.resume lines of the journal when the breaker opened; a later one is a resume by hand and closes the breaker.

last.description: The last class seen and the action taken on it (null: none); an action is not repeated while the class stays.

action.description: Action taken, null when nothing was.

resumes.description: Number of run.resume lines of the journal at that time; an action is not repeated for the same class until a resume changes it.
